lines.hook: What happens if you hold your breath?
lines.b1: For the first ten seconds or so, holding your breath feels easy.
lines.b2: By thirty seconds, rising carbon dioxide creates a strong urge to breathe.
lines.b3: After sixty seconds, your diaphragm can start to spasm and jerk.
lines.b4: By about ninety seconds, most people already feel a strong urge to gasp.
lines.end: Did you hold your breath while watching this?
